description: This file contains matcher functions for protocol detection and filtering, including HTTP/1, HTTP/2, TLS, and header field matchers, used in the cmux package for multiplexing network connections.

methods.name: PrefixMatcher
methods.description: Returns a matcher that matches a connection if it starts with any of the provided strings.

methods.name: HTTP1Fast
methods.description: Returns a matcher that quickly matches common HTTP/1 methods.

methods.name: TLS
methods.description: Returns a matcher that detects TLS handshake packets, optionally restricted to specific TLS versions.

methods.name: HTTP1
methods.description: Detects if the connection contains an HTTP/1 request by reading the first line.

methods.name: HTTP2
methods.description: Detects if the connection is HTTP/2 by checking the frame preface.

methods.name: HTTP1HeaderField
methods.description: Matches the first request's header field with a specific value.

methods.name: HTTP1HeaderFieldPrefix
methods.description: Matches the first request's header field with a value starting with a prefix.

methods.name: HTTP2HeaderField
methods.description: Matches the first headers frame's header field with a specific value.

methods.name: HTTP2HeaderFieldPrefix
methods.description: Matches the first headers frame's header field with a value starting with a prefix.

methods.name: HTTP2MatchHeaderFieldSendSettings
methods.description: Matches header field and writes settings to the server, used in HTTP/2.

methods.name: HTTP2MatchHeaderFieldPrefixSendSettings
methods.description: Matches header field prefix and writes settings to the server, used in HTTP/2.
